summary: Iteration 6 (VeriFactu optional + user certificate + connection log + monthly cron purge) tested end-to-end. Created backend/tests/test_verifactu_cert.py with 10 tests covering certificate upload validation (wrong password 400, OK returns meta), meta hides 'data'/'password', signed submit produces log with RegistroAlta/CSV/EstadoEnvio/signer, unsigned still works without cert, cron 401 without secret and clears log with Bearer secret, and user isolation. All 10 iter6 tests pass. Full regression: 38/39 pass (1 pre-existing regression in iter5 idempotency).

minor.issue: Idempotency lost: second submit no longer returns already:true and inserts a NEW connection-log entry (duplicates log per invoice). test_verifactu.py::test_submit_and_idempotent fails. Suggested fix: if invoice.verifactu.submitted is True, short-circuit and return {already: true, csv, signed} without re-inserting a log entry.

action_items: Restore idempotency in POST /api/invoices/{id}/verifactu/submit: when verifactu.submitted is true, return {already: true, csv, signed} and skip inserting a duplicate verifactu_log entry.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py verifactu_submit always inserts a new verifactu_log entry on repeated calls -> log duplication and broken idempotency contract expected by earlier tests.
server.py is 744 lines; consider splitting VeriFactu/certificate/cron endpoints into a dedicated router module for maintainability.

cron/purge-verifactu-log deletes ALL log entries globally (delete_many({})). This is fine for a monthly cron run out-of-band, but if the endpoint is exposed for manual use, consider scoping or explicit confirmation.
test_credentials: admin@fiscalhub.es / admin123; WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET read from backend/.env
seed_data_creation: Generated ephemeral self-signed .pfx via cryptography.pkcs12 in tests (TEST_ADMIN_CN, UI_TEST_CN). Created test invoices and a second registered user TEST_iter6_other@example.com for isolation tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 endpoints (upload/get/delete cert, connection-log, cron purge, signed submit) all verified. Only known failure is legacy idempotency test in test_verifactu.py. UI verified with admin: cert upload shows meta, Conexión panel shows status cards + purge notice + expandable log with request/response XML. To retest idempotency after fix, run: pytest backend/tests/test_verifactu.py::test_submit_and_idempotent. Note: login redirects to '/' not '/dashboard'; navbar shows Panel/Facturas/Gastos/Contactos/Impuestos/Conexión/Configuración.
rca of the issue: verifactu_submit unconditionally builds XML, calls simulate_aeat_response, updates invoice fields, and inserts a new verifactu_log entry every call. There is no check on inv['verifactu'].get('submitted'). Add an early return before the log insert when already submitted, preserving CSV and signed flags from the stored verifactu doc.
